copenhagen-nikolaj-tour-20261122-1400.title: Get closer to art: guided tour of Nikolaj Kunsthal
copenhagen-nikolaj-tour-20261122-1400.description: A one-hour guided tour in Danish. Ordinary adult admission at DKK 110 includes the tour; a separate package from DKK 125 also includes coffee or tea. Mandatory fees, remaining places and any advance booking requirement are unverified. Children’s general gallery admission concession does not establish a free tour package. The map point approximates the building, not a verified entrance.
